m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: We tried to rescue Queen Chasca from the Umbra Legion, but we were overpowered. Could you help us?
Thank you for freeing me and the knights! Our captain, Pachakutiq Who Shakes the Earth is trapped by the Shadow in a cave!
Greetings, Wizard. The Shadow Queen is about to find Huracan, and then the Horn Will Call.
It's not too late to enlist in the Umbra Legion. Now would be a perfect time to join up. I'd even get a bonus for convincing you.
No? I understand. The winning side is not for everyone. As a consolation, you are welcome to my prisoner. He bores me, too.
Please free me, if you have honor!
I forgot. I hypnotized the flying frog. Pachakutiq, kill the Wizard. I'll get my bonus one way or another.
Eyargh! I'll never get that promotion now!
Ugh, my head is finally clearing. Thank you, Wizard. I will meet you outside this place of darkness.
Outsider, you wish to... help us? Our village was assaulted by the Umbra Legion. They kidnapped our Queen, Chasca Dawn Hour!
Pachakutiq Who Shakes the Earth, our most renowned warrior, led a raiding party into Black Tooth Gorge to fetch her back.
But now the raiding party is missing! Can you search for the lost Winged Tooth Knights in Black Tooth Gorge?
Search for the lost Winged Tooth Knights in Black Tooth Gorge!
